fixed: In a narrow frame people stood too close together: a pointing arm reached through the person it pointed at. The scene is now laid out as many heads wide in a tall frame as in a wide one, and the camera closes in from there.
notes: In the vertical cut the walk to market has its caption over his shins and the bush.
When his wife says "Keep the gold!" the vertical frame shows her alone, pointing off to the side; Tomas is in the wide cut only.
Backgrounds are seen from closer in the vertical cut, so there is less of each place in the picture.
